changes: Lexical SSA environments restored across branches and loop iterations; enclosing axes restored after nested loops.
Carried state rebindings published into stable enclosing registers.
Let(Var) captures its current value instead of aliasing mutable storage.
New isolated validation prevents poisoned CUDA contexts from contaminating later observations.
limitations: Seven bounded grammar families; not a general typed-IR fuzzer or estimate of hidden-test success.
Reduced mode is family-specific parameter reduction, not arbitrary statement delta debugging.
Renamed counterparts and historical regressions are correlated; counts are not independent samples.
Fresh seeds are within existing families, not an unseen-family holdout.
Early unisolated runs after their first fault and scalar block_threads=0 generator runs excluded from acceptance.
Clock-unlocked target timings; resource counters/SASS/roofline remain open.
No new release archive or competition submission.
